hints.text: From Reception, take the main elevator bank to Floor 6 North — Community Cafeteria is past the North elevator lobby.
From Reception, take elevators to Floor 6, then follow signs to the South wing training rooms.
Take the central elevator to Floor 8, cross the atrium bridge, then follow South wing pod signs.
Elevator one floor up to 7 North — sitting area pods start just past the elevator bank.
Use central elevators (+2 floors). Mid-tower collaboration floors have mixed pod sizes on both wings.
Central elevator to Floor 10 South — practice leadership sessions cluster near the south pods.
Elevator to top floor — AMAs and closing celebrations; quiet terrace is on the North terrace.
On the same floor, walk through the central atrium bridge to reach the opposite wing pods.
All floors are reachable via central elevators with step-free routes from Reception — ask at the help desk for wheelchair escort.
From Basement parking, take central lifts to Ground Reception, then continue to Floor 6 — allow ~5 min for lifts during event rush.
From 2nd floor parking, central lifts to Floor 8 North — pods start just past the elevator lobby.
For a garden break, take stairs one floor down to Floor 5 — open air, fountain, and light snacks (~1 min).
One floor up? Central stairs are often faster than lifts during rush (~1 min). Use lifts if you need step-free access.
Four floors up — lifts are recommended (~5 min during event day). Stairs are faster only for 1–2 floors.
